programme.title: Mundo futuro

programme.title: Travesuras de un lobo adolescente

programme.title: Mini espías

programme.title: Mini espías 2: La isla de los sueños perdidos

programme.title: Mini espías 3D: Se acabó el juego
programme.desc: Antonio Banderas, Carla Gugino, Alexa Vega y Daryl Sabara regresan en la tercera película de la trilogía de Spy Kids en la que un malvado fabricante de juguetes (Stallone) secuestra a Carmen y la mantiene dentro de un juego de realidad virtual.

programme.title: Dora y la ciudad perdida

programme.title: No es otra tonta película de comida

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.desc: El grupo de mariachis con Letty le dan una serenata a Emiliano en la cárcel. Todos los integrantes del grupo se despiden de Emiliano y le dejan una fotografía para que siempre los recuerde. Emiliano es deportado a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano Sanchez es llevado a la misma cárcel donde se encuentra Felipe Romero. Emiliano pide que su abogado sea Miguel Corona. Por otro lado, Rubén contrata un sicario de la cárcel para que asesine a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Ronald da la orden de matar a Emiliano para que no abra la boca. Emiliano le confiesa a Felipe toda la verdad. Por otro lado, Rosario saca las cosas de Emiliano de la pensión. La manada intenta consolar a Rosario con una serenata.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El sicario contratado por Rubén tratará de asesinar a Emiliano. Con lo que no cuenta el criminal, es que el mariachi se sabe defender muy bien. Los cabecillas de la organización deberán buscar una nueva estrategia para mantener en silencio a Emiliano

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Para evitar que Emiliano se declare inocente y la policía descubra quienes son los verdaderos culpables del lavado de dólares, los socios de Corona deciden contratar a los mariachis y en medio de la serenata, se toman fotos junto a Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano es visitado por Corona y éste le muestra las fotos en que Rosario aparece junto a los cabecillas de la organización. Emiliano no tendrá otra opción que acceder a las pretensiones del abogado. Por otro lado, Rosario recibe la visa mexicana.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El comandante Salas revisa el interrogatorio y empieza a dudar de la culpabilidad de Emiliano. Por otro lado, Rosario no puede entrar al reclusorio por ser Emiliano un preso de alta seguridad. Rosario buscara la ayuda de la teniente Morales.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El encuentro en la cárcel entre Emiliano y Rosario resulta muy corto, y sirve para confirmar que la pareja se ama igual que antes. No obstante, el mariachi le advierte a su novia que lo mejor para ella es que no se vuelvan a ver.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario regresa a Colombia y es bien recibida por todos sus compañeros. Por otro lado, el doctor Javier Macías le dice a Don Carlos que deben liquidar el bar cuanto antes para poder asumir las deudas que tiene.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los muchachos de la manada intentan encontrar la forma para salvar el bar Garibaldi y dentro de esta búsqueda Rosario descubre que el culpable de esta crisis financiera es el Doctor Macías. Por otro lado, llega el día del juicio de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Al enterarse de la condena que tendrá que asumir Emiliano por unos crímenes que no cometió, Sigifredo y Fernando le escriben un correo electrónico anónimo al comandante Salas, comentándole que está cometiendo una gran injusticia.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Con dolor en sus corazones, los mariachis del bar Garibaldi se despiden. Rosario vende el traje de su papá para pagar la deuda que tiene con Javier Macías. Por otra parte, el comandante Salas decide reabrir la investigación del caso de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Han transcurrido varios meses desde el cierre del bar Garibaldi. Los integrantes de la manada no la pasan bien en sus nuevas vidas. Por otro lado, el Comandante Salas visita a Emiliano para decirle que ya sabe toda la verdad de su caso.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Las autoridades capturan a Miguel Corona y sus socios. Emiliano y Felipe recobran su libertad. Por otra parte, un empresario mexicano reabrirá el bar plaza Garibaldi.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Alejandro Villa Ruiz, el empresario que compró el bar Plaza Garibaldi, reúne a todos los integrantes del grupo de mariachis para hablarles sobre sus contratos. Además el empresario va en busca de don Carlos Malagón para proponerle que sea su socio.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano aparece por sorpresa vestido de Mariachi y con varias canciones le recuerda a Rosario que ella es la mujer de su vida. Emiliano y Rosario ahora podrán disfrutar de ese sentimiento que por las injusticias de la vida tuvieron que retener.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano otorga grandes regalos a todas aquellas personas que en su paso por Colombia lo ayudaron. Por otro lado, llega la noche esperada por todos, la velada en la que el Bar Plaza Garibaldi abrirá nuevamente sus puertas al público.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: A ritmo de ranchera, la reinauguración del Bar Plaza Garibaldi es toda una fiesta en la que Emiliano, el Coloso y Rosario deleitan al público. Terminada la reinauguración del bar, Emiliano Sanchez Gallardo y su amada viajan a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano y Rosario se preparan para presentar a sus familias y formalizar su unión en compañía de sus amigos mariachis. Lo que parecía ser la noche perfecta para esta pareja de enamorados, podría convertirse en un mal momento.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Luego de darse cuenta de su equivocación al dudar de la fidelidad de Rosario, Emiliano comienza a planear la manera de enmendar su error. Sus amigos y familiares deberán ayudar al mariachi a recuperar a la mujer con la quiere compartir su vida

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Going after two fugitives in one day is tough enough without the facing Colorado's notoriously unpredictable weather. Today it's the threat of sever thunderstorm, hail and area wide tornado warnings.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter

programme.desc: It hurts Dog to see people who after years of walking the straight and narrow, suddenly lose their way. But today's case is a member of the law enforcement community who has recently gone astray, and that truly troubles the Dog.

programme.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
programme.desc: Lawman Wyatt Earp (Burt Lancaster) and gunfighter John "Doc" Holliday (Kirk Douglas) find themselves together again in Tombstone, Ariz., despite the tumultuous history between them. Earp comes to Arizona on a mission to bring the Clayton clan to justice. Meanwhile, Holliday becomes incensed with the decision of Kate Fisher (Jo Van Fleet) to turn him down in favor of another gunfighter (John Ireland), ultimately leading Holliday to join Earp's side in a confrontation with the Claytons.

programme.title: The Tall Texan
programme.desc: Dangerous greed consumes a band of treasure-seeking travelers in the Southwest as they search for gold reputedly concealed in an Indian burial ground.

programme.desc: An immigrant tailor endures cruel jokes and malicious pranks.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: Story of a Mexican bandit's love.

programme.desc: An anthology series based on the novels of Zane Grey.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A call for justice spawns a lynch mob.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A cowboy learns that a man has murdered his friend and confiscated the victim's ranch.

programme.title: Canadian Pacific
programme.desc: Fearful of what a new railroad will mean for their lives, natives and locals become manipulated by a fur trader to sabotage its final construction.

programme.title: The Cariboo Trail
programme.desc: During the Gold Rush, two dreamers from Montana and a prospector head for British Columbia to raise cattle and dig for gold, but find trouble instead.

programme.title: Wagon Master
programme.desc: To survive a perilous crossing of the vast Utah desert, a band of Mormons must learn to collaborate with the people they meet on the trail.

programme.title: The Law vs. Billy the Kid
programme.desc: The notorious gunslinger’s new courtship with a rancher's lovely daughter is cut prematurely short when the law unexpectedly catches up with him.

programme.title: The Cimarron Kid
programme.desc: A paroled outlaw (Audie Murphy) tries to change for a rancher's daughter (Beverly Tyler), but the Dalton gang won't let him.

programme.title: Whispering Smith
programme.desc: Luke Whispering Smith (Alan Ladd) is a mild-mannered policeman tasked with stopping a gang of train robbers, led by Barney Rebstock (Donald Crisp). Luke is faced with a conflict of interest when his good friend, Murray Sinclair (Robert Preston), loses his railroad job and, in an act of defiance, joins Rebstock's gang of outlaws. To make things even more complicated, Luke's friendship with Murray's ex-wife, Marian (Brenda Marshall), is becoming romantic.

programme.title: Saskatchewan
programme.desc: Canadian Mountie O'Rourke (Alan Ladd) and his Cree companion, Cajou (Jay Silverheels), come upon the scorched remains of a wagon train and find beautiful lone survivor Grace (Shelley Winters), who claims the attack was carried out by American Indians. Realizing the attack is only the beginning, the men fear war between the American Sioux, the Canadian Cree and the whites. O'Rourke must now protect his troops from further attack and save Grace from being extradited to Montana on a murder charge.

programme.title: Riders of the Purple Sage
programme.desc: Based on the book by Zane Grey.

programme.title: Appaloosa
programme.desc: Two gunmen pursue an escaped murderer to a lawless Western town, where a mysterious widow with a dangerous agenda draws them into trouble.

programme.title: Destry Rides Again
programme.desc: The small town of Bottleneck is under the control of Kent (Brian Donlevy), a power-hungry boss who gets control over the local cattle ranchers by winning a rigged game of cards. When the local sheriff questions the legitimacy of the game, Kent has him killed and names the town drunk, Dimsdale (Charles Winninger), as sheriff. What Kent doesn't know is that Dimsdale knows legendary lawman Tom Destry, who in turns sends his daring son Tom Destry Jr. (James Stewart) to Bottleneck to save the day.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A farmer must choose between his land and his son.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A disabled gunfighter uses his son to exact revenge.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A bank teller and a female doctor find themselves caught up in robbery and murder.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A dishonored Army officer pursues a missing major for the government.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A lawman and a bounty hunter hold the fates of a young outlaw and his fiancée in their hands.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theater
programme.desc: A brave man's reputation suffers under torture.

programme.title: The Texan
programme.desc: After Longley is forced to kill a barfly that tried to shoot him in the back, he learns a quirk in the Montana law code.

programme.title: The Texan
programme.desc: While escorting to prison the leader of a notorious gang, a sheriff and a deputy are attacked by the gang.

programme.title: Bend of the River
programme.desc: Reformed outlaw Glyn McLyntock (James Stewart) has become a guide for farmers headed to Oregon. When he rescues thief Emerson Cole (Arthur Kennedy) from execution, Cole joins him on the journey. Once the settlers arrive, they discover that a trader who was supposed to send them provisions is now trying to scam them. programme.title: Bengt Washburn
programme.desc: Bengt Washburn is an Aquarius with Hazel eyes who prefers boxer briefs, solid deodorants, and Crest toothpaste. He is 5'9? tall, weighs about 149 pounds and can bench 150 pounds three times without a spotter. He has a vertical leap of 16 inches. 8 years ago a lump appeared on his right thigh. It's not visible from the stage but according to some kids at the water park, it looks creepy. Many people say Bengt looks kind of like a monkey. Bengt Washburn was born in Salt Lake City, Utah but grew up in a large Utah town (1,200 people) as the fifth child in a small Mormon family (7 children). Bengt is married to an officer in the United States Airforce. They have lived in 6 different cities over the last eleven years. Most recently he moved to Springfield, Virginia (Washington D.C.) after living in Stuttgart, Germany for 3 years. Bengt is a former winner of the prestigious San Francisco International Comedy Competition. He has been seen on The Late Late Show with Craig Fergusen, Live at Gotham on Comedy Central and most recently Conan on TBS. He was invited to perform at the Vancouver International Comedy Festival, The Boston Comedy Festival, the Aspen Laff Festival and Gilda's Laugh Fest in Grand Rapids, Michigan. He's been heard on NPR, PRI and Bob and Tom. All three of his comedy Cd's can be heard playing on XM Sirius radio. Most people who know him would say Bengt is a logistically impaired ditz, but his comedy is described as intelligent, surprisingly universal considering the content matter and profoundly funny.

programme.title: Paul Morrissey
programme.desc: Paul was raised as a sports fanatic in the tiny town of Owego, in upstate New York. After four years of playing college basketball, somehow he graduated. Aside from playing in the NBA, his dream job was to talk about sports for a living. Paul then moved to California after landing a television sports anchor job but found out quickly that he was “too much of a smart-ass” for TV news. After he was fired, Paul took his unique sense of humor to comedy club stages all over the country. In 2005, Paul was selected to perform at the HBO Comedy Festival in Las Vegas. Morrissey has also been a finalist in several national comedy competitions including Wendy's Comedy Challenge, Comedy Central's Open Mic Fight and Maxim's Real Men of Comedy.

programme.title: Key Lewis
programme.sub-title: Half Black, Half White, Looks Mexican
programme.desc: Sacramento California born Key Lewis is a high energy, improvisational, storytelling, multiple-personality nutcase! His love for the people and hunger for the stage is his undying motivation. His comedic stories about his interracial childhood, family, and unusual views on relationships, make Key simply a joy to watch. His ability to improvise and interact with all types of crowds makes this up and coming comic and actor one to look out for. Key Lewis has appeared on Marlon Wayans TBSís Funniest Wins, Starz Networks StaannDup, Kevin Harts One Mic Stand as well as Bill Bellamyís Whoís Got Jokes! Key says, chase your dream, always know your audience donít act funny, be funny... donít worry about the quantity of your material but the quality the sooner you create a relationship with your crowd, the better you will be. Television: Bill Bellamyís Whoís Got Jokes on TVONE. BETíS One Mic Stand Hosted by Kevin Hart. Starz Network Comedy Series called StaannDup, Marlon Wayanís TBSís Funniest Wins! Competitions: Winner of the 2013 Rocky Mountain Laugh Off, Finalist in the 2010 Bay Area Black Comedy Competition, Semi-Finalist 2009 San Francisco International Comedy Competition, a Semi-Finalist in the 2008 Boston Comedy Festival, 2007 Seattle International Comedy Competition Finalist, Shades of Laughs Portland Oregon Winner, TVONE Bill Bellamyís Who Got Jokeís Contestant. Radio: Improv work with FM Morning Shows (Top 40 Radio): KSFM 102.5 (Sacramento, CA), KWOD 106.5 (Sacramento, CA) KWIN 97.7 ñ Stockton/Lodi, CA, Mix 107.9 Salt Lake City UT (Is It Racist Segment) & The Man Panel. Concerts/Festivals: Opened for Jon B. and Keysha Cole, Taste Of Tacoma, & Bite Of Seattle Fountain Stage 5 Years Running! Key Lewis has worked with the likes of Kevin Hart, Pablo Francisco, Sam Bam, Alonzo Bodden, Jay London, Gabriel Iglesias, Brooks McBeth, Tommy Davidson, Katt Williams, De-Ray Davis, Andrew Norelli, Lonnie Love, Jeff Garcia, Damon Wayans, Joey Diaz, Guy Torry, Darren Carter, Paul Mooney, Kermet Apio and many more.

programme.title: Tom Clark
programme.desc: Tom Clark was born and raised, in that order. Clark's mix of well-crafted jokes and spontaneous crowd work has led to appearances on TBS's ‘Conan,' CBS's ‘Late Late Show, and Comedy Central's ‘Premium Blend'. Clark has traveled coast to coast doing stand up and has performed internationally as part of New Faces at the prestigious‘Just For Laughs Comedy Festival' in Montreal and on The Main Stage at ‘The Capetown Comedy Festival' in South Africa. Clark is also an actor and has appeared on such shows as NBC's ‘Outsourced', TNT's ‘The Closer',and the Hallmark made for TV movie ‘The Wish List'. After landing the role on ‘Outsourced,' director Ken Kwapis invited Clark to be in the Drew Barrymore movie, ‘Big Miracle'. You can also see Clark in Columbia Pictures ‘Freaks of Nature.'

programme.title: BT
programme.sub-title: My Life As I Know It Now
programme.desc: With an act that crosses all boundaries, B.T. will surely have you rolling with laughter. His physical performance style and charm landed him two performances on NBC's Friday Night Videos and a performance at the prestigious HBO U.S. Comedy Arts Festival. B.T. has also appeared on BET's Comic View, MTV's The Jenny McCarthy Show, and FOX's The Keenan Ivory Wayans Show.

programme.title: Johnny Beehner
programme.desc: Johnny Beehner puts on a funny show. He's got everything you want from a comic: He's silly, he's likeable, and he's fun. With a background in improvisational theater including training at Chicago's prestigious Second City, as well as the Upright Citizens Brigade in Los Angeles, Johnny brings a unique style to the stage. Beehner made his network television debut in January of 2015 as one of the last comedians to appear on the Late Show with David Letterman. He has made numerous appearances on FOX "Laughs" television show, and regularly appears on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Show. His comedy can be heard regularly on XM/ Sirius Satellite radio. Other notable and accomplishments of Johnny's include winning First place in Comcast's 2014 season of "Trial By Laughter," placing third in the 2014 “Laughing Skull Comedy Festival” of Atlanta, and making it to the finals in the 2012 “Great American Comedy Festival”. He was named one of Ricky Gervais' Top 5 picks in the "Just Sayin” stand up contest. Johnny was recently named one of 2015's Top10, "Hot Comics to Watch" by his wife. She says that he would have a shot at the #1 spot if he would “work just a little bit harder”. He's a married man, a new dad, and his current life goal is to win just one argument with his beautiful wife.

programme.title: Tony Deyo
programme.desc: Tony Deyo is a stand-up comedian known most notably for his sharp, quick material and near-perfect comedic timing almost certainly gained from his years as a professional symphony musician. New York City's Village Voice calls him “one of the tightest joke writers in the business.” In 2013, he made his late night television debut on CONAN. Within a year, he had added appearances on The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, AXS TV's Gotham Comedy Live, and Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen. His latest album, Comedy Road Trip, landed on the Billboard Magazine comedy chart and debuted as the #1 selling stand-up album on iTunes. With over 50 stand-up clips available, he has steadily become one of the most prolific comedians on YouTube. He performed at the prestigious HBO Aspen Comedy Festival, was named one of the year's best by the New York Post, and can be heard regularly on SiriusXM Satellite Radio.

programme.title: Lamont Ferguson
programme.desc: Ferguson has appeared on the Tonight Show, Comedy Central, Comics Unleashed and ABCís Family Channel. He was the Winner of the Seattle International Comedy Competition, Three time semi-finalist at the Boston Comedy Festival, Finalist in the San Francisco International Comedy Competition and named ëBest of Festî at the Detroit, Lucky Eagle and San Luis Obispo Comedy Festivals. He has the distinction of being one of the only comics in the country that has opened for all of the following comedians: Steve Harvey, George Lopez, Larry Miller, Garry Shandling, Richard Jeni, and George Carlin.

Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Fin del Mundo
programme.desc: Some of the fiercest weather on the planet can be experienced at the southern tip of Argentina and Chile– the area the South Americans call the “Fin del Mundo” – the end of the world. Host George Kourounis travels to Ushuaia, Argentina, sails south on the expedition sailboat “Northanger” to round infamous Cape Horn, then climbs the spectacular but rapidly melting glaciers along the Beagle Channel.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Midwest Stormfest
programme.desc: George Kourounis returns to “Tornado Alley” with three of his fellow stormchasers to see what the 2007 Storm Season will bring. He gets a birthday gift of a large Kansas tornado, then travels to Missouri to witness a string of violent thunderstorms. Heading west to Crazy Horse Mountain, the team is in place for a huge storm sweeping through the Badlands of South Dakota.
